product.title: Yellowstone and Grand Teton 4 Day 3 Night Wildlife Adventure
product.description: Researching the perfect Yellowstone itinerary can be a bit overwhelming, and sometimes it’s best to allow the pros to piece together the trip. On this exceptional 4-day tour of Grand Teton and Yellowstone national parks, your guide does that for you. Experience the park’s best sights like Old Faithful and spot a wide range of wildlife at times when they are out on the move.
highlights: 4-day wildlife tour of Grand Teton and Yellowstone national parks
Spot moose, bison and elk in Grand Teton, and bears and wolves in Yellowstone
Visit Old Faithful, Mammoth Hot Springs and more in Yellowstone
Learn about the history, geology and abundant wildlife of both parks
Accommodation, breakfast, entrance fees, and transfers included
inclusions: Hotel pickup and drop-off in Jackson, Wyoming
Snacks, water, and soda provided throughout tour
Use of binoculars for each guest and scope for group to share
National Park entrance fee (only for residents of the United States)
Guide gratuity excluded (suggested at 10-15% of tour price)

start.description: Pickup offered. Pickup point: 49'Er Inn & Suites, 330 W Pearl Ave, Jackson, WY 83001-9161. Confirm start time with local provider in advance.

pickup.description: We meet guests at the 49'er Inn and Suites (or a similar star-rated hotel in the Jackson Hole area booked by BrushBuck) where first-night lodging is set up.

itineraryItems.title: Day 1: Grand Teton National Park Dusk Adventure
itineraryItems.description: Mormon Row Historic District; Grand Teton National Park; T.A. Moulton Barn.

itineraryItems.title: Day 2: Grand Teton & Yellowstone Wildlife and the Grand Canyon of Yellowstone
itineraryItems.description: Oxbow Bend; Jackson Lake; West Thumb Geyser Basin; Yellowstone Lake (Pass By); Hayden Valley; Grand Canyon of the Yellowstone.

itineraryItems.title: Day 3: Buffalo Bill Cody Museum, Yellowstone Wildlife & Scenic Upper Loop Adventure
itineraryItems.description: Buffalo Bill Center of the West; Chief Joseph Scenic Byway; Lamar Valley.

itineraryItems.title: Day 4: Wildlife Viewing in the American Serengeti, Mammoth Hot Springs, and Old Faithful Geyser
itineraryItems.description: Lamar Valley; Old Faithful; Old Faithful Inn; Mammoth Hot Springs; Roosevelt Arch; Snake River Overlook; Fountain Paint Pot.

additionalInfo: Important: A hotel stay within the parks is not guaranteed for bookings made within 30 days of travel; accommodations may be outside the park.
A small amount of walking is involved.
